newsitem.title: USA: World Bank approves $75 mln loan to Argentina.
newsitem.headline: World Bank approves $75 mln loan to Argentina.

text.p: The World Bank said on Thursday it approved a $75 million loan to fund a project aimed at reducing rural poverty in Argentina by improving the productivity of rural farming enterprises.

The loan -- part of a $108 million "Small Farmer Development Project -- will provide direct assistance to at least 30,000 poor households, benefiting an estimated 150,000 people, the bank said in a statement.

The project was designed and will be implemented with the help of the poor people it aims to help and non-governmental organisations in the region, in addition to national and local government agencies.

The loan has a maturity of 15 years and a grace period of five years, with a 0.75 percent commitment fee for undisbursed funds. The project also received $25 million in Argentine government funds and $8 million from beneficiaries.
